fusions.name: String-Pulled Door
fusions.desc: Drops a barred door on a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. The target is stunned for 1.2 seconds and left [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Gnawed Loose
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A tearing bite deals 9 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Baited Bars
fusions.desc: Drops a baited cage ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward and slows those it catches by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Sprung Latch
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
